lxc_5bf75370d3271ea1.text: Small talk is short polite talk about safe topics like weather, weekend plans, hobbies, food, and sports.

lxc_253a86f18232cfdf.text: People in Japan, Germany, Spain, Switzerland, and the United States all use hobby talk in daily life.

lxc_88541fe68438f6f9.text: Small talk is short, polite talk.

lxc_bb315c11940754fd.text: You use it with a neighbor, a coworker, or a person at the bus stop.

lxc_2069640be1d0ebed.text: The talk is light and friendly.

lxc_017c310cf06a3855.text: Safe topics are the weather, weekend plans, hobbies, food, and sports.

lxc_deeaeef14d0f52bf.text: In daily conversation, hobbies are a safe shared topic, because most people like to talk about the things they enjoy.

lxc_aa45a825d184a649.text: People also use related everyday talk about the weather, food, and sports to keep the chat going.

lxc_da335beda919db8d.text: This kind of talk is the same in many countries, but the favorite hobby changes from place to place.

lxc_916bede8ec63ebbe.text: The next parts show some real examples.

lxc_32ee39af02985619.text: Karaoke is a very common hobby in Japan.

lxc_eb5af13e81c65520.text: Karaoke means singing with a recorded band.

lxc_64a1bc552d4782ad.text: The words show on a screen, so you can follow them as you sing.

lxc_c39b914d3a60c29b.text: In 1971, a man named Daisuke Inoue built eight coin machines in the city of Kobe.

lxc_48bd4c2b21bf0ffe.text: They cost 100 yen for one song and used 8-track tapes.

lxc_3903f32f24306bb2.text: Today, friends in Japan often rent a karaoke box by the hour.

lxc_e824f7cb1bd6d8a9.text: A karaoke box is a small private room with a screen and microphones.

lxc_8b798192245b6182.text: On Monday, coworkers may ask about the weekend, and "I went to karaoke" is an easy and friendly answer.

lxc_5b362dd2ec0b3bb0.text: Another easy weekend topic in Japan is a trip to an onsen.

lxc_3636715464329a7f.text: An onsen is a Japanese hot spring.

lxc_a39d324859260a31.text: Japan has about 25,000 hot spring sources and about 3,000 onsen places.

lxc_93ab926307f4aa79.text: Dogo Onsen in the city of Matsuyama is one of the oldest.

lxc_c389b5ee6c2a261c.text: There are simple rules: you wash first, and you do not wear a swimsuit in this kind of onsen.

lxc_f1fa592c3c3c5098.text: Some talk changes with the season.

lxc_c1cba832b6973954.text: In late March and early April, people talk about cherry trees.

lxc_f53207197e30db97.text: Hanami is a picnic under cherry trees.

lxc_8a8f061ee8cdbcd1.text: Ueno Park in Tokyo has over 1,000 cherry trees, so it is a popular place for hanami.

lxc_6531b09b684dd013.text: Weather talk and hanami talk often mix at this time of year.

lxc_829e250bc802f5e6.text: In Germany, Monday talk is often about football, and very often about FC Bayern Munich.

lxc_3eacf2f262fb87bd.text: The top league, the Bundesliga, began in 1963.

lxc_c5b268775e3f9d67.text: FC Bayern Munich play at the Allianz Arena and have 31 Bundesliga titles.

lxc_fe6edf5292950238.text: Football is not only for watching.

lxc_2e291b2f6b0255f1.text: The German football association, the DFB, has about 6.6 million members, about 8 percent of the country, and over 31,000 clubs.

lxc_22d6d5fba025d920.text: Not all weekend talk is about a match.

lxc_513d89737ce27c4e.text: In Munich, people also talk about a Sunday walk in the Englischer Garten, a big park in the city.

lxc_1192471f67a534d6.text: About 42 percent of adults cycled at least once in 2020.

lxc_f7b1cd87958b2758.text: In Spain, cafe talk often follows El Clasico.

lxc_943b4365d3ab07ea.text: El Clasico is the match between FC Barcelona and Real Madrid.

lxc_896d1612b8691496.text: The two teams first met on 13 May 1902, and Barcelona won 3-1.

lxc_dfffc235b9edd1a0.text: As of 10 May 2026, the two teams were tied at 106 wins each, with 52 draws.

lxc_839e9f2b080beea9.text: Lionel Messi scored 26 goals in these matches.

lxc_c4a33c6a834cd9e4.text: In Switzerland, hiking is the big weekend hobby.

lxc_c7806bc70d6c18d0.text: The country has more than 65,000 kilometers of marked trails, many through the Alps.

lxc_f00ae5c2c889f78f.text: About 50,000 yellow Wanderweg signs show the walking time to the next place.

lxc_05808cfc0bc2b8d8.text: About 2.7 million people, around 44 percent, hike often, so "Where did you walk this weekend" is a normal Monday question.

lxc_a9448fa0e0100b37.text: In the United States, sports talk is often about the NFL, the American football league.

lxc_722f542ee62a8e08.text: The Super Bowl is the last NFL game of the season and one of the top TV sports events in the country.

lxc_6462534ce05463ee.text: Remember, this sport is American football, not soccer.

lxc_f14a0e6eb25a230d.text: Family time and sports talk meet at Thanksgiving.

lxc_ee3f4aa48ec9873c.text: Thanksgiving is the fourth Thursday of November.

lxc_9ec4836c1fd3813e.text: A federal law fixed this date in 1941.

lxc_2b5c1054e1ad2a27.text: Families eat a big meal together, and many watch NFL games that weekend.

lxc_ee5cf63d94fe2595.text: So the small talk at the table mixes food talk and sports talk, two safe topics from Part 1.
